# Full results tables {#sec-app-tables}

\begingroup\footnotesize

```{r}
#| label: tbl-app-change
#| tbl-cap: "Simulation: mean change from the baseline on the same data sets, pooled over separation (200 replicates); MCSE in brackets."
ch <- read.csv("results/table_change_vs_baseline.csv", check.names = FALSE)
ch$classifier <- ifelse(ch$classifier == "logistic", "Lasso", "Forest")
ch$approach <- c(oversample = "Over-sampling", undersample = "Under-sampling", smote = "SMOTE",
                 weights = "Class weights", threshold = "Threshold")[ch$approach]
ch$metric <- c(roc.auc = "ROC-AUC", sensitivity = "Sensitivity")[ch$metric]
ch$n <- format(ch$n, big.mark = ",")
ch <- ch[order(ch$metric, ch$classifier != "Lasso", ch$approach, ch$n), ]
ch <- ch[, c("metric", "classifier", "approach", "n", "prev 0.01", "prev 0.05", "prev 0.2", "prev 0.5")]
names(ch) <- c("Measure", "Classifier", "Approach", "n", "1%", "5%", "20%", "50%")
kable(ch, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, align = "lllrrrrr", longtable = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-app-ens
#| tbl-cap: "EasyEnsemble minus the best single approach in each simulation setting (MCSE in brackets)."
ens <- read.csv("results/table_ensemble_sim.csv")
ens$metric <- c(roc.auc = "ROC-AUC", pr.auc = "PR-AUC", bal.accuracy = "Bal. acc.")[ens$metric]
ens$classifier <- ifelse(ens$classifier == "logistic", "Lasso", "Forest")
ens$n <- format(ens$n, big.mark = ",")
ens$prev <- pct(ens$prev)
names(ens) <- c("Measure", "Classifier", "n", "Separation", "Prevalence", "Best single",
                "Difference", "Verdict")
kable(ens, booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, longtable = TRUE)
```

\endgroup

# Code {#sec-app-code}

The analysis scripts are run in this order (each starts with
`source("R/00_setup.R")`):

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `00_check_setup.R` | checks packages and the data file |
| `01_check_gen_data.R` | sanity checks of the generator |
| `02_design_grid.R` | finds the intercepts and builds the design (1,600 rows) |
| `03_check_approaches.R`, `04_check_evaluate.R` | small tests of the remedies and metrics |
| `05_run_simulation.R` | runs the simulation in parallel, saves `sim_results.rds` |
| `06_summarise_simulation.R` | MCSE summaries, paired changes, @fig-sens, @fig-roc, @fig-gap |
| `07_run_real_data.R` | the 10 real-data splits, saves `real_results.rds` |
| `08_reconcile.R` | real-data summaries, @fig-real, @fig-tradeoff |
| `08b_compare_wadud.R` | comparison with the second implementation, @fig-agree |
| `09_run_ensemble.R`, `09b_summarise_ensemble.R` | EasyEnsemble runs and summaries, @fig-ens |
| `10_slide_figures.R` | larger-text copies of the figures for the slides |
| `11_calibration.R` | calibration check, @tbl-calib |
| `12_eda.R` | exploratory plots, @fig-simprob and @fig-ccdata |
